prerequisites: Basic knowledge from telecommunications sector courses foreseen in the degree program's educational offering.

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire basic knowledge in the field of Telecommunication Networks and their applications with specific reference to Internet Technologies in different application contexts.

Acquire basic knowledge of both classical topics and more recent and innovative themes such as wireless networks, sensor networks, and new paradigms of autonomic communications, SDN and Internet of Things.
Ability to classify the different existing or short-term foreseen telecommunication networks in relation to specific operational requirements.
Ability to understand the functioning of basic network devices.
Ability to define appropriate types of sensor networks.
Ability to select MAC and Network layer algorithms in relation to specific application needs.
Knowledge and understanding of the main aspects of the TCP/IP network and networks with ISO/OSI architecture.
Ability to analyze and model the main protocol architectures.
Ability to critically discuss and interpret sector literature.
Ability to clearly and rigorously present the architectures of various systems and their respective applications.
Ability to autonomously find technical documentation on network protocols and services.

assessment_rules: The final assessment consists of a single oral interview comprising questions to verify the acquired knowledge. This includes verifying knowledge and understanding of TCP/IP and ISO/OSI networks, the ability to analyze and model protocol architectures, the ability to critically discuss literature, the ability to clearly present system architectures and applications, and the ability to autonomously find technical documentation.
